species: Onchocerca lupi (Spirurida: Onchocercidae) is a filarial worm parasitizing domestic carnivores and humans.
tissue: Onchocerca lupi female (n = 3) and male (n = 2) specimens have been isolated from the eye of an infected dog (3-year-old, male) that died accidentally in Algarve region (southern Portugal) where O. lupi is known to occur.
disease_state: The molecular and proteomic dataset herein reported should provide a useful resource for studies on O. lupi toward supporting the development of new interventions (drugs, vaccines and diagnostics) against canine onchocercosis.
